svg.title: Wisp, live voice and the routine tools
svg.desc: Typed Wisp, live voice with Gemini Live, the routine builder, the routine check and label scan.
svg.text: Wisp, live voice and the routine tools
Gemini talks and reads; tools and rules in code supply every fact, and every answer is checked.
model calls to build a routine
to Wisp’s first word, no tool
20 QUESTIONS A DAY · ANSWER CHECKED BEFORE YOU SEE IT
a tool or your own words;
20 SESSIONS A DAY · NOTHING WRITTEN TO THE CHAT
fixed rules from sourced data pick
in: skin type, up to 3 goals, budget, market, safety
a full catalog product: its ingredient list is checked
sold where you are, and a cosmetic there
within budget, in its own currency
no flag for your profile; fragrance-free if reactive
ties: Proven first, then concern match, then price
ROUTINE CHECK · THE RULE TABLE IS FINAL
Gemini may add findings, each marked AI-suggested
1–2 photos in; JSON out: brand, name, category,
each ingredient with its own confidence, key
actives, and why it failed (glare, blurry, cut off).
Matched to the catalog; nothing is saved until
you confirm. 30 a day; an empty read is refunded
Sources: docs/GEMINI_SPEC.md §4, §5, §10, §11 · api/app/advisor.py, live.py, translate.py, plan.py, routine_check.py, label_scan.py, limits.py · evidence.json
